outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rate
cohort: The study included women with term singleton viable pregnancies following a single low-segment transverse cesarean delivery with a polyhydramnios diagnosis within 14 days before birth, who delivered between 2017 and 2021.
finding: No independent association was demonstrated between TOLAC and composite adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to PRCD in patients with term diagnosed polyhydramnios.
mod_finding: In patients with term diagnosed polyhydramnios, TOLAC appears to be a reasonable alternative associated with favorable outcomes, with an 82.2% VBAC rate and no cases of uterine rupture, hysterectomy, or maternal ICU admission in either group.
